title: English Practice Quiz 0573
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The weather can ___ your travel plans.
questions.explanation: Affect is usually a verb meaning to influence.

questions.question: The windows ___ every week.
questions.explanation: Plural subject windows takes are + past participle.

questions.question: He speaks English ___.
questions.explanation: Clearly is the adverb describing how he speaks.

questions.question: He is ___ honest man.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound. Honest begins with a silent h.

questions.question: She ___ in this hospital for five years.
questions.explanation: The present perfect can describe a situation continuing to the present.

questions.question: She is ___ university student.
questions.explanation: University begins with the consonant sound /y/, so use a.

questions.question: It ___ rain later; take an umbrella.
Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
Choose the correct WH question for a place.
questions.explanation: Where asks about a place or location.

questions.question: I have ___ my keys.
questions.explanation: Lost is the past participle of lose.
